subject.title: fix(groq): keep default Llama agent turns within TPM limit

question: Should the Groq TPM failure use this provider-specific exact-error retry, or should OpenAI-compatible transports stop reserving discovered `model.maxTokens` by default?
rationale: The two open candidate PRs solve the same failure through materially different ownership layers and compatibility scopes; repository evidence cannot determine the intended cross-provider product contract.
